meta.scopeWarning: This is gross fund-level accounting and is not additive to PPB or consolidated Secretariat expenditure. Funds without a verified entity assignment are shown under Unmapped Trust Funds; this is a display group, not a UN entity. Separate entity totals use audited non-RB expenditure where available; ITC uses reported gross XB programme delivery. Gross account/segment details must not be added to their parent total.
